meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起一次深度调研,拿到一份带引用、经过质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要就一个陌生领域查大量资料并整理出可信结论。
copy.tagline_en: Run a deep investigation and get back a cited, quality-checked research report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often dig through many sources on a new topic and need a citable result.

howto.what: 当你要求做调研时,它会先拆解方向、组建一支研究小队分工检索,追线索到收敛、让成员互相辩论,对有争议的说法用代码验证,最后交出一份每条结论都带引用或验证证据的成果。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做调研或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、“ulw” 研究字样、ultradebate 等说法时接管;普通提问和调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 帮我调研这个话题
say.note: 它会先拆方向、组队,再展开多波检索

say.text: 对这个主题做一次最大饱和度的深度调研
say.note: 边检索边写入会话日志,并追踪每条线索

say.text: 用 ultradebate 的方式查清这几个争议点
say.note: 争议结论会过辩论轮,并尽量用代码验证

howto.what_en: When you ask for research, it forms a cooperating team that fans out over sources, chases leads to convergence, debates contested claims and verifies them by running code, delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: It activates only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use wording like “ulw-research”, “ulw” research, or ultradebate. Ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic for me
say_en.note: It scopes axes, builds a team, then collects.

say_en.text: Do maximum-saturation deep research on this topic
say_en.note: Starts multi-wave collection and journals as it goes.

say_en.text: Use ultradebate to settle these contested points
say_en.note: Contested claims go through debate and code checks.
